tools.name: calculate_check_digits
tools.description: Add the GS1 check digit to GTIN numbers that are missing it (7, 11, 12 or 13 digits become GTIN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 or GTIN-14). One number per line or comma separated.

tools.name: validate_gtins
tools.description: Check complete GTIN, EAN, UPC and ITF-14 numbers: says for each one whether the check digit is right and which GTIN length it is.

tools.name: identify_code
tools.description: Find out what kind of code a string is: GTIN, ISBN, ISSN, SSCC, GLN, GS1-128 data, GS1 Digital Link, VIN, IMEI, ASIN, Amazon LPN or FNSKU, with its check digit status.

tools.name: check_amazon_code
tools.description: Read the code from an Amazon sticker: tells an LPN (License Plate Number) from an FNSKU, ASIN, FBA box label, Amazon Logistics tracking number or UPC/EAN, and explains each part. It cannot look up which product a code belongs to.

tools.name: convert_upc_e
tools.description: Convert a UPC-E (6, 7 or 8 digits) to the full 12-digit UPC-A, or a UPC-A to UPC-E when one of the four GS1 zero-suppression rules fits. Checks the check digit.

tools.name: convert_isbn
tools.description: Convert an ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 or back, with the check digit recalculated and the hyphenated form. ISBN-13 starting with 979 has no ISBN-10.

tools.name: repair_gtin
tools.description: Recover a GTIN with unreadable digits: mark each unknown digit with ? or * and get every number that passes the GS1 check digit.

tools.name: parse_gs1
tools.description: Split GS1 data (GS1-128, GS1 DataMatrix, Digital Link) into its Application Identifiers, with the name of each AI and any format error.

tools.name: make_barcode
tools.description: Draw a print-ready barcode and return it as SVG (or EPS) in millimetres, plus a link that opens it in the generator. Types: upc-a, ean-13, ean-8, itf-14, code-128, code-39, code-93, interleaved-2-of-5, codabar, msi, pharmacode, data-matrix, pdf417, aztec. GS1 retail types use magnification 80 to 200

tools.name: barcode_size
tools.description: Give the printed size of a barcode type at a GS1 magnification (retail and carton types) or an X-dimension, with the GS1 allowed range.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "identify_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
